guard.doc: Internal struct-validity guard bytes; not meaningful to callers.
guard.notes: Internal LibRaw bookkeeping (not documented as a public field); no useful JS representation.

make.doc: Camera make, as parsed from the file (may need normalization -- see normalized_make).

model.doc: Camera model, as parsed from the file (may need normalization -- see normalized_model).

software.doc: Software/firmware string embedded in the file, if any.

normalized_make.doc: Make normalized against LibRaw's camera database (canonical vendor name).

normalized_model.doc: Model normalized against LibRaw's camera database (canonical model name).

maker_index.doc: Index into LibRaw's internal maker table for normalized_make.

raw_count.doc: Number of RAW frames/images stored in this file (e.g. multi-shot/burst formats).

dng_version.doc: DNG version encoded as LibRaw packs it (0 if this is not a DNG file).

is_foveon.doc: Non-zero if this is a Foveon (layered-sensor) file.

colors.doc: Number of colors in the RAW data (1, 3, or 4).

filters.doc: CFA pattern bitmask LibRaw uses internally to decode the Bayer/X-Trans layout (0 or 9 for non-Bayer/X-Trans sensors).

xtrans.doc: 6x6 X-Trans CFA pattern (color-plane indices 0..3), only meaningful when filters == 9.

xtrans_abs.doc: 6x6 X-Trans CFA pattern in absolute (unshifted) sensor coordinates.

cdesc.doc: Color plane description string (e.g. "RGBG"), indexed by the values in filters/xtrans.

xmplen.doc: Length in bytes of the embedded XMP packet (0 if none). See xmpdata for why the packet itself is not exposed.

xmpdata.doc: Pointer to the embedded XMP packet's raw bytes.
xmpdata.notes: Raw char* into LibRaw-owned memory; exposing it safely would need a Buffer copy keyed off xmplen, which is a reasonable future addition but out of scope for T14a's core-struct mirror.

raw_height.doc: Full sensor height in raw pixels, before any cropping.

raw_width.doc: Full sensor width in raw pixels, before any cropping.

height.doc: Output image height in pixels, after LibRaw's standard crop.

width.doc: Output image width in pixels, after LibRaw's standard crop.

top_margin.doc: Rows skipped from the top of the raw sensor data to reach the cropped image.

left_margin.doc: Columns skipped from the left of the raw sensor data to reach the cropped image.

iheight.doc: Final output height after any half_size/other output-size-affecting params (equals height unless half_size etc. is used).

iwidth.doc: Final output width after any half_size/other output-size-affecting params (equals width unless half_size etc. is used).

raw_pitch.doc: Bytes per row of the raw (undecoded) sensor data.

pixel_aspect.doc: Pixel aspect ratio (width:height of one sensor pixel); 1.0 for square pixels.

flip.doc: Orientation from the file: 0 none, 3 180deg, 5 90deg CCW, 6 90deg CW (other LibRaw-internal values are possible for less common sensors). See the `sizes.oriented` convenience for swapped width/height at flip 5/6.

mask.doc: Up to 8 masked/black-frame border rectangles (each [top, left, bottom, right] in raw pixel coordinates); unused entries are all-zero.

raw_aspect.doc: Raw sensor aspect-ratio hint LibRaw derives for a few multi-aspect sensors (0 if not applicable).

raw_inset_crops.doc: Up to 2 inset-crop rectangles some makers embed (e.g. an in-camera crop suggestion), as libraw_raw_inset_crop_t.

cleft.doc: Inset crop left edge, in raw pixel coordinates.
cleft.notes: LibRaw leaves an unfilled entry at {cleft: 0xffff, ctop: 0xffff, cwidth: 0, cheight: 0} -- verified empirically (synthetic DNG, no inset-crop tags).

ctop.doc: Inset crop top edge, in raw pixel coordinates.

cwidth.doc: Inset crop width, in raw pixels.

cheight.doc: Inset crop height, in raw pixels.

iso_speed.doc: ISO speed rating as parsed from the file's EXIF/maker data.

timestamp.doc: Capture time as a Unix epoch value in seconds, exactly as LibRaw's time_t reports it (not converted to a JS Date -- construct one with `new Date(other.timestamp * 1000)` if needed).

shot_order.doc: Shot sequence number within a burst/multi-shot file, where the format records one.

gpsdata.doc: Raw, undecoded GPS IFD tag words LibRaw captured while parsing.
gpsdata.notes: Low-level parser intermediate; parsed_gps below is the decoded, useful form of the same data.

parsed_gps.doc: Decoded GPS data (latitude/longitude/altitude/timestamp and reference codes), as libraw_gps_info_t.

desc.doc: Free-text image description embedded in the file, if any.

artist.doc: Artist/photographer name embedded in the file, if any.

analogbalance.doc: DNG AnalogBalance tag (per-channel R,G,B,G2 multipliers applied before the color matrix), when present.

altref.doc: Altitude reference: '0' above sea level, '1' below sea level (ASCII digit character, not a number).

gpsstatus.doc: GPS receiver status code as recorded by the camera (maker-specific single character).

gpsparsed.doc: Non-zero once LibRaw has successfully parsed GPS data for this file (0 if the file has no GPS data).

MinFocal.doc: Minimum focal length of the lens, in millimeters.

MaxFocal.doc: Maximum focal length of the lens, in millimeters.

EXIF_MaxAp.doc: Maximum aperture as reported by the EXIF MaxApertureValue tag.

LensMake.doc: Lens manufacturer, if recorded separately from the camera maker.

Lens.doc: Lens model/name string, from whichever source (EXIF or maker-specific) LibRaw found first.

InternalLensSerial.doc: Lens's internal (maker-specific) serial number, if recorded.

FocalLengthIn35mmFormat.doc: 35mm-equivalent focal length in millimeters, from EXIF.

nikon.doc: Nikon-specific lens fields, as libraw_nikonlens_t (populated regardless of camera make in a few cross-compatible cases).

makernotes.doc: Vendor-agnostic lens-database fields LibRaw resolves from maker notes, as libraw_makernotes_lens_t.

EffectiveMaxAp.doc: Effective maximum aperture (f-number) as decoded from Nikon lens data.

LensIDNumber.doc: Nikon lens ID byte (indexes Nikon's own lens database).

LensFStops.doc: Number of f-stops in the lens's aperture range, Nikon encoding (1/12 EV units for some models -- see EXIF tools for the exact decode table).

MCUVersion.doc: Lens MCU (electronic contacts) firmware version byte.

LensType.doc: Nikon lens type flags byte (AF/AF-D/G/VR/etc. bit flags).

MinFocal.doc: Minimum focal length of the lens, in millimeters, from DNG tags.

MaxFocal.doc: Maximum focal length of the lens, in millimeters, from DNG tags.

MaxAp4MinFocal.doc: Maximum aperture (f-number) at MinFocal, from DNG tags.

MaxAp4MaxFocal.doc: Maximum aperture (f-number) at MaxFocal, from DNG tags.

LensID.doc: 64-bit lens ID as decoded from maker notes (indexes LibRaw's lens database). Number when it fits Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, otherwise a BigInt; the key is absent (not any sentinel value) when LibRaw has not filled it in.
LensID.notes: LibRaw's own unset value for this field is UINT64_MAX (all bits set, verified empirically on the synthetic DNG), not 0 -- handled specially by scripts/gen-metadata-cc.js's `uint64` case rather than this file's generic `unset` mechanism; see the top-level $comment.

Lens.doc: Lens name resolved from LibRaw's lens database using LensID.

LensFormat.doc: Image-circle format the lens covers (LibRaw's internal lens-format enum value).

LensMount.doc: Lens mount type ('male', the lens side; LibRaw's internal lens-mount enum value).

CamID.doc: 64-bit camera-body ID as decoded from maker notes (indexes LibRaw's camera database). Number when it fits Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, otherwise a BigInt; the key is absent when LibRaw has not filled it in.

CameraFormat.doc: Sensor format of the camera body (LibRaw's internal camera-format enum value).

CameraMount.doc: Camera mount type ('female', the body side; LibRaw's internal camera-mount enum value).

body.doc: Camera body name associated with CamID.

FocalType.doc: Lens focal-length type: -1 unknown, 0 unknown, 1 fixed focal length, 2 zoom.

LensFeatures_pre.doc: Lens name prefix features (e.g. mount/format markers) LibRaw splits out of the full lens name.

LensFeatures_suf.doc: Lens name suffix features (e.g. stabilization/AF markers) LibRaw splits out of the full lens name.

MinFocal.doc: Minimum focal length of the lens, in millimeters, as resolved via the lens database.

MaxFocal.doc: Maximum focal length of the lens, in millimeters, as resolved via the lens database.

MaxAp4MinFocal.doc: Maximum aperture (f-number) at MinFocal, as resolved via the lens database.

MaxAp4MaxFocal.doc: Maximum aperture (f-number) at MaxFocal, as resolved via the lens database.

MinAp4MinFocal.doc: Minimum aperture (f-number) at MinFocal, as resolved via the lens database.

MinAp4MaxFocal.doc: Minimum aperture (f-number) at MaxFocal, as resolved via the lens database.

MaxAp.doc: Maximum aperture (f-number) across the lens's zoom range.

MinAp.doc: Minimum aperture (f-number) across the lens's zoom range.

CurFocal.doc: Focal length at time of shooting, in millimeters, as resolved via the lens database.

CurAp.doc: Aperture (f-number) at time of shooting, as resolved via the lens database.

MinFocusDistance.doc: Minimum focus distance of the lens, in meters.

FocusRangeIndex.doc: Lens focus-range index (maker-specific classification of the lens's focus range).

LensFStops.doc: Number of f-stops in the lens's aperture range, as resolved via the lens database.

TeleconverterID.doc: 64-bit teleconverter ID, if a teleconverter was attached and recognized. Number when it fits Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, otherwise a BigInt; the key is absent when unset.

AdapterID.doc: 64-bit lens-mount adapter ID, if an adapter was recognized. Number when it fits Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, otherwise a BigInt; the key is absent when unset.

AttachmentID.doc: 64-bit attachment (e.g. close-up filter) ID, if recognized. Number when it fits Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, otherwise a BigInt; the key is absent when unset.

FocalUnits.doc: Divisor to convert the lens database's internal focal-length units to millimeters (1 in the common case).

FocalLengthIn35mmFormat.doc: 35mm-equivalent focal length in millimeters, as resolved via the lens database.

curve.doc: Internal 65536-entry linearization/tone lookup table LibRaw builds during processing.
curve.notes: Only meaningful mid-decode (after unpack, before/around dcraw_process) and not part of the metadata this generator mirrors -- huge (65536 entries) and internal.

cblack.doc: Per-channel/per-pattern black level correction table (LIBRAW_CBLACK_SIZE entries; encodes both simple per-color-channel and complex per-line/per-pixel-pattern black levels depending on the camera).
cblack.notes: 4104-entry internal table (LIBRAW_CBLACK_SIZE); its first few entries are the common per-channel case, the rest a maker-specific pattern encoding not worth exposing raw. color.black/color.maximum below cover the common case.

black.doc: Overall black level (baseline dark-current offset) applied during processing.

data_maximum.doc: Maximum raw pixel value actually found in this file's data.

maximum.doc: Maximum sensor value (saturation point) LibRaw uses for highlight handling.

linear_max.doc: Per-channel linear maximum values (R,G,B,G2), used for highlight reconstruction on some formats.

fmaximum.doc: Floating-point maximum sensor value, for floating-point RAW formats.

fnorm.doc: Floating-point normalization factor, for floating-point RAW formats.

white.doc: Per-corner (8x8 grid) white-level sample table some cameras embed for vignette/shading correction.
white.notes: Internal shading-correction sample grid, not part of the requested color metadata surface.

cam_mul.doc: As-shot white balance multipliers (R, G1, B, G2), from the camera/file.

pre_mul.doc: Pre-multipliers LibRaw computed for the sensor/file (used to build the final white balance when no as-shot data is available).

cmatrix.doc: 3x4 color matrix (camera RGB -> a working color space) LibRaw computed for this file.

ccm.doc: 3x4 color correction matrix embedded in the file (e.g. DNG ColorMatrix), before LibRaw's own adjustments.

rgb_cam.doc: 3x4 matrix converting camera-native RGB to output RGB, as used by dcraw_process.

cam_xyz.doc: 4x3 matrix converting camera-native RGB to CIE XYZ.

phase_one_data.doc: Phase One-specific decoding parameters, as struct ph1_t (format, black-level geometry).

flash_used.doc: Flash compensation/power value as parsed from the file, when available.

canon_ev.doc: Canon-specific exposure value adjustment parsed from maker notes.

model2.doc: Secondary/internal model string some files embed (distinct from idata.model).

OriginalRawFileName.doc: DNG OriginalRawFileName tag value, for a DNG converted from another raw format.

profile.doc: Embedded ICC color profile bytes, when the file carries one.
profile.notes: void* pointer into LibRaw-owned memory, paired with profile_length below; scripts/gen-metadata-cc.js special-cases this field to copy profile_length bytes into a fresh Buffer when the pointer is non-null, and to omit the key entirely (never an empty Buffer) when it is null -- the one documented exception to "pointer fields are unsupported" (docs/plan/tasks.md's T14a Do list).

profile_length.doc: Length in bytes of the embedded ICC profile (0 if color.profile is absent).

black_stat.doc: Internal black-level statistics accumulator (sum/count pairs) used while computing color.black.
black_stat.notes: Internal accumulator, not a documented public metadata field.

dng_color.doc: Up to 2 DNG color calibration sets (e.g. for two calibration illuminants), as libraw_dng_color_t.

dng_levels.doc: DNG black/white level and crop metadata, as libraw_dng_levels_t.

WB_Coeffs.doc: Per-illuminant white balance coefficient presets (256 possible illuminant/CCT slots, [R, G1, B, G2] each) LibRaw parsed from the file's maker notes.
WB_Coeffs.notes: Compacted: scripts/gen-metadata-cc.js emits only the illuminant slots that are actually set (any non-zero coefficient) as `[{ illuminant, coeffs: [r, g, b, g2] }]`, per docs/plan/tasks.md's T14a Do list, instead of the full fixed-size 256-entry table (almost entirely zero for any given file).

WBCT_Coeffs.doc: Per-color-temperature white balance coefficient presets (64 possible slots, [CCT, R, G1, B, G2] each) some makers embed.
WBCT_Coeffs.notes: Compacted the same way as WB_Coeffs, keyed on CCT > 0 instead of illuminant index: `[{ colorTemperature, coeffs: [r, g, b, g2] }]`.

as_shot_wb_applied.doc: Non-zero if the as-shot white balance was already applied to the raw data by the camera/converter (rare; e.g. some compressed raw formats).

P1_color.doc: Up to 2 Phase One color calibration sets, as libraw_P1_color_t.

raw_bps.doc: Bits per pixel/sample of the raw data (Phase One: raw format code instead -- see the header's field comment for the code table).

ExifColorSpace.doc: EXIF ColorSpace tag value (e.g. 1 = sRGB, 0xffff = uncalibrated).

key_off.doc: Phase One decryption key offset within the file.

tag_21a.doc: Raw value of Phase One maker-note tag 0x21a (undocumented by Phase One; used internally by the decoder).

split_col.doc: Column at which the sensor's dual-readout halves split, for split-sensor Phase One backs.

black_col.doc: Column index of the black-reference columns.

split_row.doc: Row at which the sensor's dual-readout halves split, for split-sensor Phase One backs.

black_row.doc: Row index of the black-reference rows.

tag_210.doc: Raw value of Phase One maker-note tag 0x210 (undocumented by Phase One; used internally by the decoder).

parsedfields.doc: Bitmask of which DNG color-calibration fields this set actually parsed from the file.

illuminant.doc: DNG CalibrationIlluminant tag value (standard illuminant code) this calibration set applies to.

colormatrix.doc: 4x3 DNG ColorMatrix (camera RGB -> XYZ under the calibration illuminant).

forwardmatrix.doc: 3x4 DNG ForwardMatrix (XYZ -> camera RGB, the inverse-direction calibration some DNGs embed).

parsedfields.doc: Bitmask of which DNG level/crop fields this struct actually parsed from the file.

dng_cblack.doc: DNG per-pattern black level table (LIBRAW_CBLACK_SIZE entries), the DNG-tag counterpart of color.cblack.
dng_cblack.notes: Same rationale as color.cblack above: a 4104-entry internal table.

dng_black.doc: DNG BlackLevel tag value (single black level), when the file uses the simple (non-per-pattern) form.

dng_fcblack.doc: Floating-point DNG per-pattern black level table (LIBRAW_CBLACK_SIZE entries), for floating-point DNGs.

dng_fblack.doc: Floating-point DNG BlackLevel tag value, for floating-point DNGs.

dng_whitelevel.doc: DNG WhiteLevel tag values, one per color plane.

default_crop.doc: DNG DefaultCropOrigin + DefaultCropSize as [originX, originY, width, height].

user_crop.doc: DNG user-crop rectangle, relative to default_crop, as [top, left, bottom, right] fractions.

analogbalance.doc: DNG AnalogBalance tag (per-channel R,G,B,G2 multipliers), as parsed directly into this DNG-specific struct.

asshotneutral.doc: DNG AsShotNeutral tag (per-channel neutral white balance values).

baseline_exposure.doc: DNG BaselineExposure tag value (EV adjustment recommended by the DNG author).

LinearResponseLimit.doc: DNG LinearResponseLimit tag value (fraction of full scale where the sensor's response stops being linear).

rawopcodes.doc: Up to 3 DNG opcode-list entries (OpcodeList1/2/3), as libraw_dng_rawopcode_t.

len.doc: Length in bytes of this DNG opcode-list entry's raw data.

data.doc: Pointer to this DNG opcode-list entry's raw (undecoded) opcode data.
data.notes: Raw void* into LibRaw-owned memory; DNG opcode lists are an advanced, format-specific feature out of scope for T14a's core mirror.

romm_cam.doc: 3x3 ROMM (ProPhoto RGB reference space) to camera-RGB matrix, flattened row-major to 9 values, for Phase One files.

CameraTemperature.doc: Camera body internal temperature in degrees Celsius, when recorded.

SensorTemperature.doc: Sensor temperature in degrees Celsius, when recorded.

SensorTemperature2.doc: Secondary sensor temperature reading in degrees Celsius, when the camera records more than one.

LensTemperature.doc: Lens temperature in degrees Celsius, when recorded.

AmbientTemperature.doc: Ambient (environment) temperature in degrees Celsius, when recorded.

BatteryTemperature.doc: Battery temperature in degrees Celsius, when recorded.

exifAmbientTemperature.doc: Ambient temperature in degrees Celsius, from the EXIF/MakerNote ambient-temperature tag specifically.

exifHumidity.doc: Relative humidity percentage, from EXIF, when recorded.

exifPressure.doc: Atmospheric pressure in hPa, from EXIF, when recorded.

exifWaterDepth.doc: Water depth in meters, from EXIF, for underwater housings that record it.

exifAcceleration.doc: Acceleration magnitude, from EXIF, when recorded.

exifCameraElevationAngle.doc: Camera elevation angle in degrees, from EXIF, when recorded.

real_ISO.doc: Measured (actual) ISO sensitivity, when the camera records one distinct from the nominal ISO in other.iso_speed.

ColorSpace.doc: EXIF/MakerNote color space code (maker-specific encoding; compare against the relevant vendor's documented values).

firmware.doc: Camera firmware version string, when recorded outside idata.software.

ExposureCalibrationShift.doc: Exposure calibration shift, in EV, some cameras record as a fine metering correction.

afdata.doc: Autofocus-related maker-note data blocks actually present in this file (see afcount), as libraw_afinfo_item_t.
afdata.notes: Fixed-size LIBRAW_AFDATA_MAXCOUNT (4) slots in the C struct; scripts/gen-metadata-cc.js emits only the first `afcount` entries (the rest are unused/zero slots).

afcount.doc: Number of afdata entries actually populated (0..4).

AFInfoData_tag.doc: Maker-note tag ID this autofocus data block was read from.

AFInfoData_order.doc: Byte order (TIFF-style, e.g. 0x4949/0x4d4d) this autofocus data block was encoded with.

AFInfoData_version.doc: Version number/tag of this autofocus data block's internal format.

AFInfoData_length.doc: Length in bytes of this autofocus data block's raw payload.

AFInfoData.doc: Pointer to this autofocus data block's raw (undecoded) payload bytes.
AFInfoData.notes: Raw uchar* into LibRaw-owned memory; decoding autofocus point layouts is maker-specific and out of scope for T14a's core mirror.

ColorDataVer.doc: Canon color-data maker-note record version number.

ColorDataSubVer.doc: Canon color-data maker-note record sub-version number.

SpecularWhiteLevel.doc: Canon specular (saturation) white level parsed from color-data.

NormalWhiteLevel.doc: Canon normal white level parsed from color-data.

ChannelBlackLevel.doc: Per-channel (R,G1,B,G2) black level from Canon color-data.

AverageBlackLevel.doc: Average black level across channels from Canon color-data.

multishot.doc: Canon multi-shot-mode per-channel data (e.g. Dual Pixel/HDR shot info).

FlashExposureLock.doc: Canon flash exposure lock (FE lock) flag.

ManualFlashOutput.doc: Canon manual flash output level code.

SensorWidth.doc: Canon sensor width parsed from maker notes, in pixels.

SensorHeight.doc: Canon sensor height parsed from maker notes, in pixels.

MakernotesFlip.doc: Orientation flag Canon records in maker notes (LibRaw-internal flip encoding).

RF_lensID.doc: Canon RF-mount lens ID code, when an RF lens is attached.

AutoLightingOptimizer.doc: Canon Auto Lighting Optimizer setting code.

HighlightTonePriority.doc: Canon Highlight Tone Priority setting code.

Quality.doc: Canon recording-quality code (see the header comment for the value table).
Quality.notes: LibRaw's own header comment documents -1 as "n/a" for this field (the only Canon field with a documented sentinel; every other Canon field here has no such comment, so no `unset` is applied even though the struct is zero-initialized before parsing -- see this file's per-vendor sentinel-rule note).

CanonLog.doc: Canon Log data-compression curve code (0 off, 1 CLogV1, 2 CLogV2, 3 CLogV3).

DefaultCropAbsolute.doc: Canon default absolute crop rectangle, as libraw_area_t.

RecommendedImageArea.doc: Canon recommended image area rectangle, as libraw_area_t.

LeftOpticalBlack.doc: Canon left optical-black (masked border) rectangle, as libraw_area_t.

UpperOpticalBlack.doc: Canon upper optical-black (masked border) rectangle, as libraw_area_t.

ActiveArea.doc: Canon active (non-masked) sensor area rectangle, as libraw_area_t.

ISOgain.doc: Canon [AutoISO, BaseISO] gain pair, per ExifTool convention.

t.doc: Top edge, in pixels (0,0 is the top-left pixel).

ExposureBracketValue.doc: Nikon exposure bracketing step value, in EV.

ImageStabilization.doc: Nikon VR (vibration reduction) status byte record, raw undecoded bytes.

FlashExposureCompensation.doc: Nikon flash exposure compensation, raw undecoded byte record.

ExternalFlashExposureComp.doc: Nikon external flash exposure compensation, raw undecoded byte record.

FlashExposureBracketValue.doc: Nikon flash exposure bracketing value, raw undecoded byte record.

FlashExposureCompensation2.doc: Nikon flash exposure compensation, secondary encoding.

FlashExposureCompensation3.doc: Nikon flash exposure compensation, tertiary encoding.

FlashExposureCompensation4.doc: Nikon flash exposure compensation, quaternary encoding.

FlashSource.doc: Nikon flash source code (built-in vs external).

FlashFirmware.doc: Nikon external flash unit firmware version, raw 2-byte record.

ExternalFlashFlags.doc: Nikon external flash configuration bit flags.

FlashOutputAndCompensation.doc: Nikon flash output and compensation combined code.

FlashGroupControlMode.doc: Nikon commander flash-group control mode, raw undecoded byte record.

FlashGroupOutputAndCompensation.doc: Nikon commander flash-group output/compensation, raw undecoded byte record.

NEFCompression.doc: NEF compression type code (see the header comment for the value table).

LensDataVersion.doc: Nikon lens-data maker-note record version number.

FlashInfoVersion.doc: Nikon flash-info maker-note record version number.

ColorBalanceVersion.doc: Nikon color-balance maker-note record version number.

key.doc: Nikon maker-note decryption key byte (derived from the file's serial number/shutter count).

NEFBitDepth.doc: Nikon NEF per-component bit depth values.

HighSpeedCropFormat.doc: Nikon high-speed-crop format code (see the header comment for the value table).

SensorHighSpeedCrop.doc: Nikon high-speed-crop sensor rectangle, as libraw_sensor_highspeed_crop_t.

SensorWidth.doc: Nikon sensor width parsed from maker notes, in pixels.

SensorHeight.doc: Nikon sensor height parsed from maker notes, in pixels.

PictureControlVersion.doc: Nikon Picture Control maker-note record version number.

PictureControlBase.doc: Nikon Picture Control base preset name this one derives from.

ShotInfoVersion.doc: Nikon shot-info maker-note record version number.

ShotInfoFirmware.doc: Firmware version string recorded in the Nikon shot-info block.

BurstTable_0x0056_len.doc: Length in bytes of the Nikon burst-table (tag 0x0056) raw payload.

BurstTable_0x0056.doc: Pointer to the Nikon burst-table raw payload.
BurstTable_0x0056.notes: Raw uchar* into LibRaw-owned memory; a maker-specific undecoded burst-mode record, paired with BurstTable_0x0056_len -- out of scope for this generator (pointer fields are unsupported).

MakernotesFlip.doc: Orientation flag Nikon records in maker notes (LibRaw-internal flip encoding).

RollAngle.doc: Camera roll angle in degrees, positive is clockwise, from Nikon maker notes.

PitchAngle.doc: Camera pitch angle in degrees, positive is upwards, from Nikon maker notes.

YawAngle.doc: Camera yaw angle in degrees, positive is to the right, from Nikon maker notes.

cleft.doc: High-speed-crop left edge, in raw pixel coordinates.

ctop.doc: High-speed-crop top edge, in raw pixel coordinates.

CameraType.doc: Sony camera-type code parsed from maker notes.
CameraType.notes: See this file's per-vendor sentinel-rule note: LibRaw's header comments document this field's C-level "init in" default explicitly, unlike most other vendor fields.

Sony0x9400_version.doc: Decoded format version of Sony maker-note tag 0x9400 (0xa/0xb/0xc per ExifTool convention).

AFAreaModeSetting.doc: Sony AF area mode setting code.
AFAreaModeSetting.notes: See this file's per-vendor sentinel-rule note: LibRaw's header comments document this field's C-level "init in" default explicitly, unlike most other vendor fields.

AFAreaMode.notes: See this file's per-vendor sentinel-rule note: LibRaw's header comments document this field's C-level "init in" default explicitly, unlike most other vendor fields.

AFPointSelected.notes: See this file's per-vendor sentinel-rule note: LibRaw's header comments document this field's C-level "init in" default explicitly, unlike most other vendor fields.

AFPointSelected_0x201e.doc: Sony selected AF point index, tag 0x201e encoding.
AFPointSelected_0x201e.notes: See this file's per-vendor sentinel-rule note: LibRaw's header comments document this field's C-level "init in" default explicitly, unlike most other vendor fields.

nAFPointsUsed.doc: Number of Sony AF points reported as in-focus/used.

AFPointsUsed.doc: Sony AF point index bitfield/list actually used for this shot.

AFTracking.notes: See this file's per-vendor sentinel-rule note: LibRaw's header comments document this field's C-level "init in" default explicitly, unlike most other vendor fields.

AFType.doc: Sony AF system type code (e.g. phase- vs contrast-detect).

FocusLocation.doc: Sony focus point location [x, y, width, height] in sensor coordinates.

FocusPosition.notes: See this file's per-vendor sentinel-rule note: LibRaw's header comments document this field's C-level "init in" default explicitly, unlike most other vendor fields.
